verdict.rationale: Workload identity federation is a fair question for a cloud provider, so the axis applies, but the pack has no evidence of OIDC or workload identity federation that issues short-lived credentials to CI or services. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: CLI token-based authentication without a keypair is a user-session alternative, and identity-domain SSO is human authentication. Neither shows keyless CI or workload federation documented end to end.
